runs: See a post (or several) you love and want to keep in one place that you can revisit? Bookmarks lets you save posts in a timeline for easy, quick access at any time.
From your timeline, tap to open an individual post
Tap the Bookmark icon . You will be prompted that the post has been Bookmarked and will be given the option to view all of your saved Bookmarks
Alternatively, you can view your saved Bookmarks by opening the “Bookmarks” tab on your nav menu.

To remove a saved Bookmark, tap the Bookmark icon from the post details on a post within your Bookmarks timeline. You can also tap the more icon at the top of your Bookmarks timeline to remove all of your Bookmarks at once.

Bookmarks FAQ
Will anyone be able to see my bookmarks?
No, Bookmarks are private and are only viewable to you within your >x< account.
Are Bookmarks the same as Lists?
No, Lists are comprised of posts from other accounts by group, topic, or interest, and are discoverable. Learn more about
Can I use Bookmarks in Spaces?
